query:
SELECT 
  fr.id,
  fr.client_email,
  fr.client_name,
  fr.vessel_name,
  fr.total_amount / 100 as total_reais,
  fr.booking_id,
  fr.is_operational,
  fr.created_at,
  b.client_email as booking_client_email,
  b.client_name as booking_client_name
FROM fuel_records fr
LEFT JOIN bookings b ON fr.booking_id = b.id
WHERE fr.client_name LIKE '%Vinicius%' OR fr.client_email LIKE '%vinicius%' OR fr.client_email LIKE '%freitas%'
ORDER BY fr.created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
